tests.name: Catalog includes four heroes, twelve distinct weapons and twelve relics
HoaVi passive charges from hits; Debug consumes stacks and mana
Firewall restores health, grants a shield and blocks hostile shots
Every ultimate, including Overclock drones and burning hits, never recharges itself
Both weapon slots have independent clips, reload and upgrades
Split, piercing and dash relics change actual attacks
A relic found outside level-up grants its advertised stat effect
Truc has a single miniboss, Sen starts defense, Tro spawns destructible cores
Defense only completes at its timer, failure is retryable and cannot award an early seal
Boss progression enforces seals, then adds roots and a third phase
Weapons can be found in chests and picked up by F
Lore rewards a relic and Dom highlights nearby discoveries
Expanded save round-trip preserves both weapons, modifiers, armor, challenge and dynamic enemies
Legacy 0.1 saves migrate without losing player upgrades or seals
Missing coordinates are rejected and missing optional expansion fields recover safely
A weapon at a completed shrine never blocks F activation or traps the player in swaps
Saving during the root phase never duplicates boss weak points
Village is safe and failed challenges reset after respawn
New Game Plus varies worlds, scales enemy health and preserves selected hero
New runtime assets exist and JavaScript files parse without remote runtime dependencies
